295:t_003:1.en:
$$尸刻$$
「You arrived early. What of the matter involving those $$メガノイド$$s?」

295:t_003:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「It's settled. ...More precisely, it was already settled.」

295:t_003:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hey, $$尸空#pilot$$... It's been a while. It wouldn't kill you to say hello.」

295:t_003:5.en:
$$メール$$
「He's ignoring $$ガンレオン$$ completely! Let's call it Gan-gnoring!」

295:t_003:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Basically, we just don't see eye to eye with this guy at all!」

295:t_003:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「There's no need to waste words on him! I'll beat him down with brute force!」

295:t_003:10.en:
$n
「Your praise doesn't make me happy in the slightest!」

295:t_003:12.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Come, $$いがみ合う双子$$. Today, I'll give you three minutes.」

295:t_004:5.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$... I will dispose of you here.」

295:t_006:0.en:
$n
「He crossed that distance in an instant...!」

295:t_006:1.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「At the Third Stage, I can perform feats like this.」

295:t_006:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「A pity, $F. I thought you could reach this level, but circumstances would not allow it.」

295:t_006:3.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I cannot let them have your $$スフィア$$.」

295:t_006:5.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「If you dislike pain, don't resist.」

295:t_008:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Is it really you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...!?」

295:t_008:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「What the hell!? Were you playing dead!?」

295:t_008:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「We'll discuss that later, $$セツコ$$, $$ランド$$. We'll strike down $$沈黙の巨蟹$$ here.」

295:t_008:7.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I followed him to Mars, but this is an unexpected find.」

295:t_008:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Then, cliched as it may sound to you, I'll call him here as a parting gift for your journey to the afterlife.」

295:t_009:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Don't worry. His target right now is $$沈黙の巨蟹$$.」

295:t_009:7.en:
$$シン$$
「$$アサキム$$ joined forces with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!?」

295:t_009:8.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Could the person who freed him from the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ have been...」

295:t_009:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Now, $n... Let's fight together again.」

295:t_009:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You can't trust me. ...But I can't blame you.」

295:t_011:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「For the world, for its people, $$ダイターン３$$ will crush the ambitions of evil!」

295:t_011:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「If you do not fear the radiance of this sun, come at me!」

295:t_012:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「I told you, $$尸空#pilot$$. Now that I've defeated the $$メガノイド$$s, I'll devote all my strength to fighting $$サイデリアル$$.」

295:t_012:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「What!? So you were the one who beat those $$メガノイド$$s, Big Bro $$万丈$$!」

295:t_012:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「Sorry, $$勝平$$. I left you all to struggle while I took care of some business.」

295:t_012:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't worry about it! It looks like that business is finished too!」

295:t_012:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You'll fight alongside us again, $$万丈$$!」

295:t_012:7.en:
$$万丈$$
「I'll make up for being late with some overtime, President.」

295:t_012:9.en:
$$ガロード$$
「He's just what he looks like. His presence alone brightens things up.」

295:t_012:10.en:
$$ロラン$$
「He truly is a man with the sun at his back.」

295:t_013:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「Sorry to ask so soon after meeting you, but could I have your support?」

295:t_013:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「I don't know what happened, but a shock that leaves you frozen on the battlefield isn't something you can shake off easily.」

295:t_014:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$沈黙の巨蟹$$, $$尸空#pilot$$... Shall we start over?」

295:t_015:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Very well. The cast is assembled.」

295:t_016:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$c. $$アサキム$$ and I will support you.」

295:t_016:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Can we trust you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$?」

295:t_016:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「Leaving you aside, I can't trust that $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$.」
